name: hallmark
description: Anti-AI-slop design skill for Claude Code, Cursor, and Codex.
one_liner: A rulebook an AI coding tool follows so the websites it builds for you don't look like every other AI-made site.
buyer: A solo SaaS founder or indie hacker shipping their own landing page or app UI with an AI coding tool, who's embarrassed that it looks generic and 'AI-made.'
business_use_cases: A freelance developer installs Hallmark into their AI coding workflow and markets 'AI-built sites that don't look AI-built' as a premium service to small-business clients.
A no-code/low-code agency uses it as an internal quality gate so every AI-assisted client site clears a design bar before delivery.
A design-conscious indie founder uses the 48 built-in themes to quickly ship a landing page that looks custom-made instead of templated.

money_ideas.idea: Offer paid custom theme creation or a full redesign/audit service for teams that want a Hallmark-quality look but don't want to configure it themselves.
Sell a curated theme pack beyond the free 48 to design-conscious indie developers.

steal_this: Run Hallmark's audit against three local small-business websites, then offer each owner a paid redesign showing the before/after.
